issues.title: Side menu "Add block" (+) not usable with keyboard
issues.summary: Tab lands on a cloned Add block button from the closing side-menu snapshot; Enter and Space do nothing, then focus falls to the page body. The live Add block button also ignores Enter and Space.

fix.label: 3 local static variants
fix.note: Both fixes, inert-only and activation-only are built in this lab. No upstream PR was opened.

steps: Hover the first paragraph in either editor so the side menu appears, then click it to place the caret.
Press Tab. In Before, focus lands on the cloned Add block button and then falls to the body. In Both/Inert, it reaches the adjacent Focus after editor control.
Focus Focus after editor, press Shift+Tab twice to reach Add block, then press Enter and Space. The menu opens only in Both/Activation.
Switch the Fix variant between Both, Inert only and Activation only and record which symptom changes.

checks.check: Tab from the hovered first paragraph
Enter/Space on the live Add block

issues.title: Tab does not work when highlighting multiple items
issues.summary: Tab does not move focus predictably when several blocks are selected. The core selection and focus interaction needs a state matrix before a patch.

fix.label: No fix yet
fix.note: No local or upstream patch is bundled on this page. Use these steps to record the current behavior.

steps: Select several blocks, for example by Shift+clicking or dragging across them.
Press Tab and record document.activeElement and whether focus leaves the editor.
Repeat with a text selection, a multi-block selection and a list selection.
Record whether Escape clears the selection and restores a predictable focus position.

checks.current: Tab does not work as expected; record the actual focus

checks.check: Tab after Escape clears the selection

issues.title: Missing alternative text field for images
issues.summary: Image and file blocks do not expose a clear alternative-text field; the formatting toolbar exposes a preview toggle instead. PR #3337 changes the media controls and adds an alt fallback.

fix.label: PR #3337 (open)
fix.note: The PR is not bundled in this static page. Open it, or run its head locally, to compare the media toolbar and alt fallback.

steps: Insert an image block and select it.
Open the formatting toolbar / file controls and look for the alternative-text field.
Check whether the old preview toggle is still present.
Clear the image name and inspect the rendered alt attribute for a fallback.

checks.check: Alternative-text field on a selected image
checks.expected: Present; PR #3337 adds the alt hint/control

checks.check: Alt fallback when name is empty

issues.title: Table headers are not associated with data cells
issues.summary: Table header cells do not expose id/scope relationships and data cells do not reference their headers. PR #3215 adds decorations and serialization for explicit header relationships.

fix.label: PR #3215 (open)
fix.note: The PR is not bundled here. Its source changes are large and include tests and snapshots.

steps: Create a table with at least one header row and one header column.
Inspect the DOM: each th should have id and scope, and each td should reference its header(s).
Navigate the table with a screen reader's table commands.
Copy or export the table and inspect the serialized HTML.

issues.title: Structure document lists correctly in reading mode
issues.summary: Read-only list output does not consistently expose list, listitem and group relationships. A wrapper or plugin design is likely needed; there is no one-line fix.

fix.label: No fix yet
fix.note: No local or upstream patch is bundled. Record the current read-only/accessibility-tree output.

steps: Open a read-only editor containing nested bullet, numbered and check lists.
Inspect the accessibility tree or DOM for list, listitem and group roles.
Export the document and inspect the serialized list HTML.
Compare the read-only output with the editable editor.

checks.check: Nested list structure in reading mode

issues.title: Merged table cells do not expose clear header relationships
issues.summary: Merged cells can have multiple applicable headers, but the current output does not make those relationships explicit. PR #3215 is intended to cover this case.

fix.label: PR #3215 (open)
fix.note: Not bundled here; validate the merged-cell cases against the PR.

steps: Create a table with merged rows and columns and at least two headers.
Inspect the merged cell's headers/scope relationships in the DOM.
Navigate it with a screen reader and record which headers are announced.
Repeat for row spans and column spans.

issues.title: Bilingual documents: unable to declare language on foreign language passages
issues.summary: There is no way to declare the language of a passage inside a document. The representation (inline mark vs block attribute) needs design before code.

fix.label: No fix yet
fix.note: No local or upstream patch is bundled; this needs a design decision first.

steps: Create a paragraph containing a passage in a different language.
Look for a way to mark that passage's language.
Inspect whether any lang attribute is emitted in the DOM or export.
Record the closest workaround and its limitations.

issues.title: Improve table and videos accessibility in BlockNote
issues.summary: A broad request covering table captions/names and video accessibility. It needs to be split into concrete table and video work items.

fix.note: No local or upstream patch is bundled; split the request before implementing.

steps: Insert a table and try to add a visible or accessible caption/name.
Inspect the table's accessible name and header relationships.
Insert a video and inspect its controls, captions track and accessible name.
Record which parts belong to table work and which belong to video work.

issues.title: Keyboard workflow for deleting a table is not explained
issues.summary: The downstream documentation does not explain how to delete a table with a keyboard. This is a docs fix, not a BlockNote runtime change.

fix.label: Downstream docs change
fix.note: No local runtime bundle; improve the downstream documentation after #2854 is resolved.

steps: Open the downstream docs for tables and keyboard shortcuts.
Try to find the documented way to delete a table without a pointer.
Follow the current instructions and record where they stop.
Draft the missing keyboard route and add it to the docs.
